note: County park campground at the Macon County Park (fairgrounds) on US-63 South in Macon, on two gravel loops at the south-east corner of the grounds; open to travelers, not only to events. The dump station is $15 to use. The park hosts fairs, shows and a demolition derby, when the sites may be busy. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: county page posts $25/night, FCFS (no reservations), 47 full-hookup + more W/E sites, showers, year-round public restrooms, dump ($15) - open to the public, not event-only. Fees/booking/water-sewer/facilities now manual; amperage not stated (30A derived left). Pin ~240 m off (on a fair building); phone 660-651-6516 to add.
flags: PIN (move ~240 m): stored 39.7212,-92.4628 is on a fairgrounds building north-west of the campground. Imagery shows the RV loops (gravel, pedestals, RVs parked) in the south-east corner of the grounds east of the pond; move to 39.7202,-92.4603.

PUBLIC NIGHTS: the county's own page (maconcountymo.com/rental-and-camping-rate-information) prices 'Camping: $25.00 per night', 'No reservations are required for camping. Camp sites are on a first come, first serve basis.', and the park page lists 'campers from near and far' among its users - an ordinary public night is sold, not event-only. No weekly/monthly or seasonal rate is marketed, so the long-stay tests do not apply. Nothing on the county's pages says the RV sites close during fair or event dates; the park hosts the Old Time Flywheel Reunion, a demolition derby, truck and tractor pull and horse shows.
PHONE (missing): the county page gives (660) 651-6516 for park reservations/information (Park Administrator Rose Kelsh per the board page) - add it.
HOOKUPS: amperage is not stated on the county page; the stored 30A came from the old note and is left derived (unverified). Water/sewer at 47 sites confirmed.
SEASON: stored year-round (derived) left alone: the page says the restrooms 'are open to the public year round' but makes no statement about the campground's season.
